method.candidates: top 20 fastest same-life transits per pair from the route-graph machinery (evidence/route_graph.json); 'chain' pairs (no direct edge exists) use best-effort same-life A->...->B windows (first arrival at B after leaving A, latest departure per arrival, life guard identical, cap 30 s)
method.vet: pipeline/human_paths.py vet(), unchanged: >=12 samples/s, max 3-D sample gap 220 u (rejects teleports and recording gaps), max half-second rise 95 u unless floor-supported within 64 u (stairs OK, rocket jumps rejected via dm3.bsp floor probe)
method.path: every 3rd trajectory sample of the surviving run, [x,y,z] rounded to 0.1 u
method.honesty: fastest_raw_s is the fastest candidate BEFORE vet (often a teleport or rocket jump); the reference line is fastest_vetted; pairs with no survivor say so explicitly
